subtitle: A three-mile steel-town beach in Swansea Bay, regenerating its seafront as the blast furnace behind it goes dark.
spike_statement: Port Talbot's blast furnace closed 30 September 2024; Aberavon's seafront masterplan of hot tubs, saunas and beach huts was approved 5 February 2025.

levers.photo_tone: Grey Atlantic surf under the steelworks skyline, the new timber-and-amber seafront catching low evening light.
